inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The primary caregiver did not inform licensing that the operation is offering nighttime care, transportation, and field trips.       Correction: CCR reviewed nighttime care, transportation, and field trips in Minimum Standards. The primary caregiver agreed and understood the importance of notifying licensing about any changes within the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §747.301(6))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting: The primary caregiver has not completed transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting (26 TAC §747.1314)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The primary caregiver operation policy is missing animal s procedures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The primary caregiver has 2 pets, and 2 pet records were not reviewed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing: 2 out of 4 children's records were not reviewed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Children's Product Certification form was not provided during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers: The home did not have emergency telephone numbers posted.

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: During the inspection the home was found to not have a carbon monoxide detections sysetem as required.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan (26 TAC §747.501(12))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The home did not have the keeping children safe poster posted as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The home was found to not have the correct fire extinguisher. The extinguisher was 1-A:10-BC.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During review of safety the home was found to have electrical outlets uncovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in the Home, on Field Trips: During review of safety the home was found to not have a first aid kit as required by minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Available in the Home, on Field Trips (26 TAC §747.3801)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough of the home I observed cleaning supplies in an unlocked cabinent in the restroom accessible to children, I oberved a BIC lighter and candle on a shelf above the toilet.   In the backyard I observed 2 water tables with standing water a toy wheelbarrow with standing water, I observed a broken fence board. I also observed a dead garden snake on the patio as well as a hook hanging from a gate that could possibly cause a hanging hazard.   A can of off spray on a table     I observed a filing cabinet tip when opened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File: During the inspection the home was found to not have a emergency and relocation diagram as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection I observed a 23 month old watching television.       This was corrected when the applicant turned the tv off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Smoke Detectors: The home was found to not have installed smoke detectors in rooms where children are cared for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §747.5113)

occurrences.finding: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children: During the inspection I observed a BB gun on a bookshelf. The applicant also had a pocket knife on the waistband of their pants.     This was corrected when the applicant placed the BB gun outside of the home,  in the garage where children do not have access to and removed the pocket knife.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered: During the inspection it was determined that home was subject to regulation was operating without a permit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
